products.name: Merino Wool Sweater
products.short_description: A relaxed crew-neck in extra-fine merino, knitted in a soft natural tone.
products.description:
Knitted from extra-fine merino wool, this crew-neck is light enough to layer and warm enough to wear on its own. Ribbed collar, cuffs and hem hold their shape wear after wear, and a softly dropped shoulder gives an easy, relaxed line.

Merino is naturally breathable and temperature-regulating, so it stays comfortable from early autumn into spring.

100% extra-fine merino wool. Hand wash cold and dry flat.
products.image_alt: Natural-tone merino wool crew-neck sweater with ribbed collar, cuffs and hem

products.name: Organic Cotton Tee
products.short_description: The everyday crew-neck tee, cut from dense organic cotton jersey.
products.description:
An essential, made properly. Our crew-neck tee is cut from a dense, smooth organic cotton jersey that softens with every wash without losing its shape.

A clean neckline, a straight hem and a regular fit make it the base layer for everything else in the collection.

100% GOTS-certified organic cotton. Machine wash cold.
products.image_alt: Stone grey organic cotton crew-neck T-shirt laid flat

products.name: Linen Button Shirt
products.short_description: A crisp white shirt in washed European linen, with a single chest pocket.
products.description:
Washed European linen gives this shirt a soft hand and a relaxed drape from the first wear. A neat point collar, a single patch pocket and a gently curved hem keep the look clean, tucked in or worn loose.

Linen breathes in the heat and gets better with age.

100% European linen. Machine wash cold, line dry.
products.image_alt: White linen button-up shirt with a chest pocket on a wooden hanger

products.name: Cashmere Scarf
products.short_description: A generous ivory scarf in pure cashmere, finished with a soft fringe.
products.description:
Woven from pure cashmere and brushed for extra softness, this generous scarf wraps easily and sits light around the neck. The ends are finished with a fine, hand-twisted fringe.

A quiet ivory that works with every coat in the collection.

100% cashmere. Dry clean or hand wash cold.
products.image_alt: Ivory cashmere scarf with fringed ends hanging from a wall hook

products.name: Wool Coat
products.short_description: A single-breasted overcoat in dense black wool, cut to the knee.
products.description:
Our signature overcoat is tailored from a dense, felted wool blend that keeps out the wind without adding bulk. Notch lapels, a single button and deep patch pockets give it a clean, architectural line.

Cut to the knee with room to layer a sweater underneath.

80% wool, 20% recycled polyamide. Fully lined. Dry clean only.
products.image_alt: Black single-breasted knee-length wool coat with notch lapels on a hanger

products.name: Cotton Dress
products.short_description: A button-through midi dress in navy cotton, with turned-back sleeves.
products.description:
A collarless button-through dress in crisp organic cotton poplin. Short sleeves with a turned-back cuff and a straight, easy shape make it as right with sandals as it is layered under the wool coat.

Falls to mid-calf, with horn-effect buttons the full length of the front.

100% organic cotton. Machine wash cold.
products.image_alt: Navy short-sleeved button-through cotton midi dress on a wooden hanger
